purpose.account: We use this data to create and manage your account, confirm your email, keep your session secure and help you when you write to us. We do not sell it or pass it on for advertising.
purpose.verification: We use your identity document, the photograph of your face and your bank account for one thing only: to confirm you are who you say you are before letting you list, and to be able to pay you for what you sell. They are not shown to anyone else and are not used for anything else.

howItWorks.title: How Sendik works
howItWorks.intro: Buying or selling fashion online in Colombia usually means transferring money to a stranger and waiting, or shipping and waiting. Sendik stands in the middle with the same rules for both sides.

browse.title: You pick an item
browse.body: Every listing was reviewed before it appeared, and it shows the item from eight angles, with its size, its real measurements in centimetres and its declared condition. One item, one listing: what you see is the exact piece you receive.

pay.title: You pay for the item plus shipping
pay.body: Shipping is quoted with the carriers and the amount is approximate; you see it before you confirm. The Sendik commission is not added to your total: the seller covers it.

hold.title: The payment is held
hold.body: Your payment is collected and held by the payment gateway. It does not reach the seller while the item is on its way.

confirm.title: You confirm and it is released
confirm.body: Once you receive the item and confirm it matches the listing, the payment is released. If you neither confirm nor report anything within the claim window, it counts as confirmed.

claim.title: If what arrives is not what was listed
claim.body: You have {{dias}} business days from delivery to report it from your order, with photos of what you received. While the report is open the payment stays held, so the refund comes out of that money and does not depend on the seller cooperating. If the report is accepted, you get back the price of the item and the shipping you paid, and the seller covers the return freight.
claim.warning: Confirming delivery closes the window. If something is off, report it before you confirm.

notCovered.title: What the report does not cover
notCovered.body: A size that does not fit the way you expected, or a colour that looks different on screen, is not grounds for a report, as long as the item matches the listing. That is why every listing carries real measurements in centimetres: measure a garment that fits you well and compare before you buy.
notCovered.retracto: Separately from this, Colombian law grants a right of withdrawal, with its own deadlines and exceptions. It is set out in the terms and conditions.

verify.title: You get verified
verify.body: You validate your identity document, send a selfie and register a bank account in your name. It is free and done once. Only individuals of legal age can sell.

publish.title: You list
publish.body: The capture assistant guides you to shoot the item from eight angles and crops everything to the same ratio, so your photos look like the rest of the catalogue. You declare size, measurements in centimetres and condition. Listing costs nothing.

review.title: We review
review.body: Every listing goes through review before it appears. If something is missing, we tell you what to fix and you send it back.

ship.title: You ship
ship.body: When someone buys, the payment is already held. You ship with the carrier and register the tracking code.

charge.title: You get paid
charge.body: You receive the price of the item minus the {{comision}} commission, into the bank account you verified. It is released when the buyer confirms delivery, or when the claim window closes.

duties.title: What you take on
duties.describe: Describing the real condition, including stains, wear and loose seams. Measurements in centimetres are required: they are the number one cause of claims in second-hand fashion.
duties.refund: If the item does not match the listing, or arrives with damage you did not declare, you cover the return freight and the buyer gets their refund.
duties.forbidden: No replicas or counterfeits, no used underwear, nothing outside fashion and accessories, and no items with undeclared damage.

about.title: Why Sendik exists
about.intro: A great deal of second-hand clothing is bought and sold in Colombia, but it happens in Facebook groups, Instagram stories and WhatsApp chats. The buyer transfers and waits. The seller ships and waits. Both take on a risk nobody is covering.
about.gathers: Sendik gathers that scattered supply into a single catalogue and adds four things a chat does not have: sellers verified with an identity document, every listing reviewed before it appears, photos that show the item from eight angles, and a payment that does not reach the seller until the buyer confirms they received what was listed.
about.notUs: We do not make clothing and we do not resell it, and we do not touch the money: the payment gateway collects and holds it. We are the place where one person buys from another under rules that are clear to both.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: What people ask most before buying, or before listing something for the first time.

real.q: How do I know the seller is real?
real.a: Every seller validates their identity document, a selfie and a bank account in their name before they can list. Selling anonymously is not possible.

whoGetsPaid.a: The payment is collected and held by the gateway, not by Sendik. The seller does not receive it while the item is on its way.

release.q: When does the seller get paid?
release.a: When you confirm you received the item and it matches the listing. If you neither confirm nor report anything within the claim window, it counts as confirmed and the payment is released.

claim.q: What if what arrives is not what was listed?
claim.a: Until you confirm delivery the payment stays held. You have {{dias}} business days from delivery to report it from your order, with photos of what you received. The refund comes out of that money and does not depend on the seller cooperating: if the report is accepted, you get back the price of the item and the shipping you paid, and the seller covers the return freight. Confirming delivery closes the window: if something is off, report it before you confirm.

fit.q: It does not fit. Can I return it?
fit.a: A size that does not fit, or a colour that looks different on screen, is not grounds for a report. That is why every listing carries real measurements in centimetres. Separately, Colombian law grants a right of withdrawal, with its own deadlines and conditions, set out in the terms and conditions.

shippingCost.a: It depends on the destination, the weight and the size. It is quoted with the carriers and you see it before you pay. The amount is approximate. Shipping is paid by the buyer, and the Sendik commission is not added to your total.

payment.a: With PSE, Nequi, Bancolombia a la mano and debit or credit card through Wompi, or in instalments with Addi. Cash on delivery is not available.

multiSeller.q: Can I buy from two sellers at once?
multiSeller.a: Yes, but it creates two orders, one per seller, each with its own shipping and its own progress.

commission.a: {{comision}} of the item price, paid by the seller and only when you sell. Shipping is not part of the calculation. Listing is free.

payout.a: The payment is released when the buyer confirms delivery, or when the claim window closes without them confirming or reporting. It is paid out to the bank account you verified, not to a balance inside the platform.

requirements.q: What do I need in order to sell?
requirements.a: Your identity document, a selfie and a bank account in your name. Only individuals of legal age, and the account has to belong to the holder of the document.

photos.a: Eight shots of the item at 45 degrees, which the capture assistant guides you to take and crops to the same ratio. From those come the four required views — front, both sides and back — and the 360° view.

new.a: Yes. Sendik has a catalogue of both new and second-hand, and every listing states its condition.

forbidden.a: Replicas or counterfeits, used underwear, anything outside fashion and accessories, and items with damage you do not declare.

moderation.a: Because a clean catalogue is what makes it worth buying here. Every listing goes through review, no exceptions. If it is rejected, you are told why and what to fix, and you can send it back.

stock.q: Can I list two identical items in one listing?
stock.a: No. One item, one listing. If you have two of the same, they are two listings.

dispute.q: What happens if the buyer files a report?
dispute.a: If the item does not match the listing, or arrived with damage you did not declare, you cover the return freight and the buyer gets their refund. Describing the real condition well is the best way to keep it from happening.

decision.title: Decide
decision.noteHint: The seller reads this. Tell them what to fix. Don't include third-party information or details of legal proceedings.

listing.title: Moderation
listing.confirm: Take this listing down? It stops showing in the catalog and the seller receives the reason. It cannot be reactivated.

seal.title: Moderation
seal.confirm: Revoke this person's seal? They stop being able to publish and receive the reason by email.
seal.listingsStayVisible: What they already published stays visible. To remove it, each listing has to be taken down separately.
